purpose: Discover publication and bibliographic candidates (PubMed / Crossref lineage) for NeuroAI-relevant literature via offline fixture or replay pages.
inclusion: Public bibliographic records with durable identifiers (PMID, DOI)
Retraction and correction lifecycle metadata when present in the source
exclusion: Treating a bibliographic hit as clinical evidence or regulatory authorization
Inferring system capability from a paper title alone
Live HTTP inside the discovery package

identity_key.name: doi_or_pmid
identity_key.match_rule: Exact DOI or PMID. Case-fold DOI namespace only; never fuzzy-merge distinct DOIs.

denominator_policy: Caller-supplied result-set size is a raw denominator. Cursor completion is not literature recall.
pagination_policy: Terminal pagination must be explicit in coverage. Missing next-page tokens on non-final pages fail closed.
known_identity_reconciliation: Optional DOI/PMID to source_id map. Exact identity matches emit DUPLICATE.
cadence: Human-gated. Offline fixture/replay only in this programme maturity.
raw_input_boundary: Caller supplies already-retrieved bibliographic payloads. Discovery has no embedded live HTTP client.
human_review_path: Candidate proposals remain PENDING_HUMAN_ACCEPTANCE until adjudicate_candidate_source.

evaluation.precision_method: Sampled human review of NEW candidates (not executed by this software).

boundary: SU-PUBS offline programme execution emits candidates and coverage. Presence of this contract does not establish literature completeness, retraction recall, or assessment effect.
